purpose: Qualify evidence assertions, recipient and purpose admission, data minimisation, correction propagation and action boundaries for a hypothetical cross-participant fraud-intelligence contract.

source_register.authority: Association of South African Payment Providers
source_register.title: Strategic positions and priorities for 2026/2027
supports: September 2026 position supports shared fraud intelligence with lawful purpose, permitted purposes, data quality, correction, appeal and retention requirements
Position supports consistent fraud-liability treatment and customer protection
does_not_support: A private platform's authority to share personal information

source_register.title: Positioning the SARB's Payments Ecosystem Modernisation Programme: A Strategic Shift to a Higher Equilibrium
supports: Proposes a future NPU baseline fraud-protection capability
Proposes participant reporting of suspected and actual fraud and transaction-level risk scoring across channels and participants
does_not_support: Operational availability of the proposed service
Participant-specific sharing permission or production API
A public blacklist or automatic adverse-action rule

source_register.title: Payments Ecosystem Modernisation Industry Dialogue, 9 April 2026
supports: SARB reported the fraud framework had been developed and priority items were being scoped
SARB reported the insights platform remained in stakeholder alignment
does_not_support: A live fraud exchange, scoring endpoint or service level agreement

source_register.title: Payments Ecosystem Modernisation Working Groups
supports: A Fraud and Intelligence Information Sharing Forum exists for knowledge exchange among private-sector PEM stakeholders

source_register.title: Financial Sector Regulation Act 9 of 2017, section 251
supports: Section 251 scopes SARB/regulator information sharing to statutory duties and listed purposes including fraud prevention, detection, reporting and remedy
Section 251 imposes safeguards, purpose limitations and written processes for authorised and sufficiently senior officials
does_not_support: A blanket private-platform licence to share personal information
A universal lawful basis for every payment participant or processing purpose

source_register.authority: Republic of South Africa / Information Regulator
source_register.title: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013
supports: Sections 10 and 13 require adequate, relevant and non-excessive processing for a specific lawful purpose
Sections 14 to 16 address retention, restricted processing where accuracy is contested, compatible further processing and information quality
Sections 23 and 24 address access and correction; section 26 covers personal information about alleged commission of an offence as special personal information
does_not_support: A generic permission for cross-participant fraud profiling
A conclusion that a synthetic review state establishes a live lawful basis

source_register.title: Instant Payments Regulation and Verification of Payee
supports: EU Verification of Payee provides match, close match, no match or other before payment initiation
Verification of Payee is a name/account verification service and not a fraud-guilt adjudication
does_not_support: South African law or participant requirements
A fraud score, adverse decision or criminal determination

source_register.title: APP scams reimbursement dashboard for Q1 2026
supports: For the in-scope UK Faster Payments APP-claim cohort from 7 October 2024 to 31 March 2026, 88 percent of APP scam losses by value (£316m) were reimbursed
82 percent of claims were closed within five business days and 98 percent within 35 business days
does_not_support: A comparable South African recovery rate
A fraud-intelligence API or transaction-level suspicion rule
A causal effect attributable to Mycelix

profiles.notes: Synthetic participant contract only. Real private-participant disclosure requires controller-specific lawful-basis and privacy review.
Section 251 is scoped to SARB/regulator duties and safeguards. Synthetic profile only; does not confer statutory status or sharing permission.
Knowledge-exchange profile only. Does not model live customer-level fraud data sharing.
Identity/account match comparator, not fraud guilt or a South African rule.
Aggregate outcome-statistics comparator, not a transaction risk signal or South African recovery baseline.
Programme proposal/progress only. Cannot be used to claim operational NPU exchange capability.
